issues.display_title: Issue #341: Dashboard: refresh Recent tiles after delete and publish toggle (bug #333)
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Fix task for bug #333 (deleted project still appearing in the dashboard Recent tiles).

Root cause

The backend is correct: project delete is a GORM soft delete and /v1/projects/recent automatically excludes soft-deleted rows. The bug is in the dashboard hook src/app/dashboard/useDashboard.ts: the recent state is fetched only once on mount (load()); handleDelete refreshes the All-projects list and counts but never refetches recent, so a deleted project's tile stays in Recent until a full page reload. handlePublishToggle has the same gap — the status chip on a Recent tile goes stale after publish/unpublish.

Scope

  • Refetch listRecentProjects() after delete and after publish/unpublish in useDashboard.ts.

Acceptance criteria

  • Deleting a project removes its tile from Recent without a page reload.
  • Publishing/unpublishing updates the status chip on the Recent tile without a reload.
  • Typecheck, lint, tests pass.

RESULT

No FE code change needed — the original diagnosis was wrong. useDashboard.ts already optimistically removes deleted/publish-toggled projects from its Recent state, and both listProjects / listRecentProjects server actions fetch with cache: "no-store".

The real root cause is backend: /v1/projects/recent did not filter is_complete = true while the All-projects list does, so abandoned wizard drafts kept appearing as Recent tiles. Fixed in GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#97 (commit ea37239, merged to BE development as d6bca8e). Verify on the dashboard once the backend deploys.

Copy now routes through the shared copyToClipboard helper.

issues.display_title: Issue #319: Editor: rename fp_history localStorage key and clear it on leaving editor/preview
issues.main_description_html:
Context

analisa key localStorage on the editor turned up the per-level undo/redo cache written by src/lib/newEditor/editor/history.ts.

Two problems:

  1. Key format inconsistent. History used fp_history_{level_id} (underscore) while the wizard blob uses gothru_wizard:{projectId} (colon). Colon is the better separator — level ids are nanoids, so the underscore form is ambiguous to grep and to prefix-match.
  2. Never cleaned up. No removeItem for that prefix existed anywhere in the repo. Deleting a level or a project left its stacks behind permanently. Each entry holds up to 40 undo + 40 redo full-model JSON snapshots (walls, doors, windows, icons, roomNames, manualAreas, shapes, roomHeights), so a busy session can push the origin toward the ~5MB localStorage quota on its own. Both saveHistory and the wizard autosave swallow quota errors silently, so a full quota kills wizard autosave with no user-visible signal.

Scope

  • Change key format to fp_history:{level_id}.
  • Clear fp_history* when the user leaves the editor and when they leave preview.
  • Leave the wizard blob (gothru_wizard*) alone — it should survive leaving the editor.
  • Leave pre-existing legacy fp_history_* entries alone at load time (no migration); the exit sweep removes them incidentally.
  • Rename ClearWizardCacheOnLeave → ClearEditorHistoryOnLeave, since it no longer touches wizard cache.

Acceptance criteria

  • History persists and restores under fp_history:{level_id}
  • Leaving /editor or /preview removes all fp_history* keys
  • Navigating editor ⇄ preview does not wipe history (round trip keeps undo)
  • gothru_wizard*, gf_project_id, mapthru_editor_split, theme survive the sweep

issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

src/store/useMapStore.ts (522 lines, 68 set() calls, plus a 375-line useMapStore.types.ts) mixes two distinct lifecycles in one store: wizard state (currentSetupStep, uploadedFiles, floorConfigs, location) and editor state (activeLevelId, activeTool, canvasData, generatedTwin, floorSettings). Every editor feature can accidentally touch wizard state and vice versa, and the file is the hottest merge-conflict point in the repo.

Scope

  • Split into a wizard slice and an editor slice — Zustand slice pattern or two stores; decide during implementation based on cross-slice dependencies (floorConfigs is used by both flows)
  • Keep the public useMapStore API compatible (re-export / combined hook) so the ~100+ call sites don't all change in this PR
  • Split useMapStore.types.ts along the same boundary
  • Existing tests keep passing; add store tests for any moved logic that lacks them

Acceptance Criteria

  • Wizard and editor state live in separate modules with an explicit boundary
  • No component behavior change; call sites untouched or mechanically updated
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

RESULT

Split the 522-line useMapStore.ts into four slice modules under src/store/mapStore/ using the Zustand slice pattern:

  • projectSlice.ts (52 lines) — persistence/session: projectId, projectName, isSaving, lastSavedAt, hasUnsavedChanges + setters, markSaved/markUnsaved
  • wizardSlice.ts (78 lines) — setup flow: currentSetupStep, lastVisitedStep, location, addressLoading, uploadedFiles + upload actions

issues.display_title: Issue #363: Audit all eslint-disable suppressions — remove removable ones, justify keepers
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

The codebase carries 34 eslint-disable comments concentrated in setup/editor components: 18x @next/next/no-img-element, 13x react-hooks (9 exhaustive-deps + 4 set-state-in-effect), 2x @typescript-eslint (no-explicit-any, no-unused-vars), plus one migrated with FloorThumbnail (#362). Each react-hooks suppression is a potential deferred useEffect bug — stale closures or missed re-runs. They have never been audited one by one.

Scope

  • Audit every eslint-disable site individually: is the suppression removable by fixing the underlying dependency/typing, or is it a legitimate documented pattern (imperative init, hydration gate, untyped upstream data)?
  • Remove the removable ones by fixing root cause (proper useCallback deps, extracting stable callbacks) — never by widening deps into re-run loops
  • Keep legitimate suppressions; each keeper must have an explanatory comment at the site
  • no-img-element sites serving blob//api/files URLs are legitimate (next/image cannot optimize them) — verify, don't churn

Acceptance Criteria

  • Every removable react-hooks suppression removed with root-cause fix, no behavior change
  • Remaining suppressions each carry a documented justification
  • Audit table in the issue RESULT: site → verdict (removed / kept + reason)
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

RESULT

Audited all 34 eslint-disable sites one by one. 4 removed with root-cause fixes, 30 → 29 remain (one line was a double-suppression site), every kept react-hooks suppression now carries an inline justification.

Removed (root-cause fixed):

Site Fix
MapTransformControl.tsx RotateKnob (exhaustive-deps) getAngle moved inside the callback; real deps [onDragStart, onRotate, onDragEnd] — all parent handlers are stable useCallbacks, so no re-render churn
MapTransformControl.tsx ScaleHandle (exhaustive-deps) real deps [onDragStart, onScale, onDragEnd]
ShareMembersPanel.tsx (exhaustive-deps) refresh wrapped in useCallback([projectId]); effect deps [refresh]
FloorPreviewModal.tsx (exhaustive-deps) go wrapped in useCallback([items.length]); effect deps [isOpen, go] — fixes a latent stale-closure risk in the keyboard nav

Kept — legitimate, now documented at the site:

  • MapLibreCore.tsx (exhaustive-deps) — mount-only imperative map init; re-running destroys the map. Prop changes handled by dedicated effects.
  • StepListFloor.tsx (exhaustive-deps) — seed effect keyed on .lengths deliberately; depending on the arrays would re-run on its own write.
  • EditLevelModal.tsx (exhaustive-deps) — mount-only floorConfig seed; same self-write loop hazard.
  • useCollab.ts (exhaustive-deps) — socket reconnect keyed on identity/project/engine only; including getActiveLevelId would tear down the connection every render.
  • ShareMembersPanel.tsx (set-state-in-effect) — verified the rule fires even through an async fetch; setState after await is not a sync render cascade. Documented.
  • PreviewOverlay.tsx, ThemeModeToggle.tsx, useCollab.ts, FloorplanEditor.tsx (set-state-in-effect) — hydration gates / external-system wiring; already had explanatory comments.
  • 18× @next/next/no-img-element — images are blob URLs / /api/files uploads / user-provided remote URLs; next/image cannot optimize them.
  • overlay.ts (no-explicit-any) — untyped upstream overlay.json, documented at the site.
  • draw-helpers.ts (no-unused-vars) — intentional stub keeping redraw2D's call site unchanged, documented.

Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

Scroll-zoom on the map stops working when the cursor is over an object label marker.

Root cause: src/components/editor/map-markers/MapObjectMarkers.tsx renders each label as a <button> with pointer-events: auto inside an overlay div above the maplibre canvas. Wheel events land on the button and never reach the map canvas, so MapLibre's scroll-zoom handler never fires. (The canvas-drawn floor-plan labels in useFloorPlanLabels are pointer-events: none and are not affected.)

Affects every surface that mounts MapObjectMarkers: editor Map mode, preview, embed/live.

Scope

  • Forward wheel events from the marker overlay to the map canvas (re-dispatch on map.getCanvas()), so zooming works with the cursor over any label while clicks/hover/drag on the markers keep working
  • No visual change

Acceptance Criteria

  • Label click-select, hover tooltip, and point-marker drag (#276) still work
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

RESULT

Root cause: each object label in MapObjectMarkers.tsx is a <button> with pointer-events: auto inside an overlay div above the maplibre canvas. Wheel events landed on the button and never reached the canvas, so MapLibre's scroll-zoom handler never fired — the map would not zoom while the cursor was over a label (editor Map mode, preview, embed/live).

Fix: the marker overlay wrapper now has an onWheel handler that re-dispatches the wheel event onto map.getCanvas() (new WheelEvent(e.type, e.nativeEvent) clones delta/position/modifiers). Editor modal z-index / stacking bug.
